## Description

Helper functions for `lavaan` models [@RCoreTeam-2026]:
conversion between `lavaan` model matrices and
reticular action model (RAM) matrices,
the standardized solution from RAM matrices,
and the parameter estimates of a fitted model
including fixed parameters, defined parameters, and constraints.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `lavHelper` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/lavHelper) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/lavHelper")
```

## Example

```{r}
library(package = "lavHelper")
```

A regression of `mpg` on `wt` and `disp` fitted with `lavaan`.

```{r}
fit <- lavaan::sem(
  model = "mpg ~ b1 * wt + b2 * disp",
  data = mtcars
)
lav_mod <- lavaan::lavInspect(
  object = fit,
  what = "est"
)
```

`Lav2RAM()` converts the `lavaan` model matrices to RAM matrices.

```{r}
ram <- Lav2RAM(
  lav_mod = lav_mod
)
ram$A
```

`StdRAM()` gives the standardized solution.

```{r}
StdRAM(
  ram_est = ram
)$A
```

`RAM2Lav()` converts RAM matrices back to `lavaan` model matrices.

```{r}
RAM2Lav(
  ram = ram,
  lav_mod = lav_mod
)$beta
```

`ThetaHat()` extracts the parameter estimates,
including the fixed parameters.

```{r}
ThetaHat(
  object = fit
)$est
```
